text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-INC-4312 fired for service: /inference-request-queue -> HIGH backlog. metrics: queue_length=12,300, enqueued/s spike, dropped=3,400. Autoscaler controller reported repeated reconciliation errors. Links: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/queue/inference-queue | https://pd.redwood.company/incidents/PD-INC-4312

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty notification: PD-INC-4312 (Capacity backlog) — triggered 03:42 UTC. Triggered on policy: queue_backlog_threshold. Escalation policy: eng-oncall rotation.

Maria V: acked. I'm taking pager — starting triage. First glance: 99p latency for inference API jumping, errors in the worker logs showing autoscaler failing to create nodes.

Maria V: quick status dump from grafana: 1) queue length peaked at ~12k 2) request drop rate ~5% in last 10m 3) average token latency increased from 0.6s -> 2.8s 4) host capacity usage near 100% on GPU pool A

Ken (ops): any logs from the scale controller? runbook id?

Maria V: grabbing controller logs now, looks like repeated 403/429 from cloud provider quota api when requesting more instances. `autoscaler-controller` logs around 03:35: 
```
E 03:35:12 controller.go:214 reconcile failed: request to cloudprovider quota denied: rate limit exceeded
E 03:35:18 controller.go:214 reconcile failed: request to cloudprovider quota denied: rate limit exceeded
```
This matches the period where it tried to add nodes but got throttled.

AJ: if autoscaler can't request nodes we should manually scale the deployment to drain queue. Can you run manual scale? Also tag eng-platform.

Maria V: manual scale started — bumping pool and deployment. Running: 
```bash
kubectl --context=prod scale deploy/inference-workers -n redwood --replicas=18
# and request cloud provider to add 10 nodes to gpu-pool-A
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for deploy/inference-workers: replicas -> 18 (triggered by Maria V).

Maria V: manual scale executed, cloud provider request submitted (support ticket created INS-9876). Watching queue...

~2m later~

Maria V: queue draining, current length 3.2k and falling. 99p latency trending down to 1.1s. Dropped requests decreasing. Looks like manual scale helped.

Ken (ops): good. We should disable the autoscaler or prevent it from attempting further quota calls while provider RC is rate-limiting. Recommend flipping autoscaler to manual mode and creating a short-term emergency pool.

Maria V: I set HPA/autoscaler to pause (annotation `autoscaler.redwood.io/paused=true`) and created emergency nodepool request in the console.

Jules: tagging eng-platform and infra on-call; we need root cause: why did controller hit provider rate limits? also cost impact eval. 

Samir: FYI — customer impact: a subset of hosted customers saw 5–8% increase in 5xxs and queued latency for their inference endpoints between 03:33–03:46 UTC. We should notify support and CS with a short blurb.

AJ: handoff time ~03:50 UTC — Maria, do you have a concise summary I can take through the next hour?

Maria V: Handoff summary for AJ (oncall next): - Incident PD-INC-4312: capacity backlog due to cloud provider quota/rate-limiting on node creation; autoscaler retried and failed causing queue buildup. - Mitigation applied: manual scale of inference-workers to 18 replicas, requested emergency nodes (INS-9876), paused autoscaler. Current state: queue length 1.1k and decreasing, latency recovering. - Next actions: eng-platform to investigate provider rate-limits/credentials and add retry/backoff or token-bucket; SRE to run a short postmortem; notify customers via status page.

AJ: ack — taking over. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate with eng-platform. Please drop any logs or notes here if anything regress.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-4312 acknowledged by Maria V at 03:44 UTC, assigned to AJ for follow-up.

Maria V: created follow-up ticket: RH-3241 (autoscaler: handle provider rate limits better) and assigned to eng-platform. Also opened a customer incident note for Support: CS-2987.

Jules: thanks. Once eng-platform has a root-cause we'll decide whether this needs an RCA. Looks like medium customer impact.

Samir: I've posted a short status update for affected customers on status.redwood.company/incidents with the summary from Maria.

AJ: monitoring. If queue bottoms and no regression in 30m I'll move to resolved and close PD.

incident-bot: PD-INC-4312 status: acknowledged, mitigation in progress.

Maria V: quick note — we saw autoscaler metric `reconciliations_failed` go from 0 -> 27 in a 10m window. I'll attach controller logs to RH-3241.

AJ: thanks all. If anyone sees a spike please ping me directly.

~end of thread~
